Sad
Sep 2016 • Solo
I walked in and was very impressed. Great customer service and very very clean (two things uncommon in saigon) I'm a chef so when I see a kitchen as clean as this is get excited. Sadly the salad was bad. I ordered the chicken Cesar. Always a safe order for me. What I got was anything but. First off the dressing was horrible. No lemon, no anchovy, no garlic, no olive oil. I tasted some of the dressing plain and I honestly would not have know it was spose to be cesar. Then they decided to add black olives and hard boiled eggs in it. Two things that shouldn't go in a Cesar salad. While the chicken was tasty, it was dry. I really wanted to like this place. It's too bad. I hope they fix these issues and I can come back and love it and delete my review.

Welcome Addition To Healthy Salad Food Scene
Mar 2016
The closure of Beets (also on same street, Ham Ngi) bummed me out quite a bit since it was my goto place for healthy salad. It also demonstrates how hard it is to keep your business afloat in highly competitive Saigon with skyrocketing real estate/rent. 

I gave WowBox Salad Bar a go and am glad I did. Now I have a credible replacement for Beets. I really recommend their slow-pressed gac juice (fruit native to Vietnam rich in nutrients). They have variety of salad that you can also customise. 

Added to the whole convenient factor is their ability to deliver to nearby area.

'A Gem of a find'
Jun 2015 • Couples
One of the smallest places that I have ever eaten at , but that actually adds to the whole experience and who cares when you are dining on the truly wonderful salads on offer.
The staff are very friendly, the salad bar is spotlessly clean and once inside one is made very welcome. 
 I have now dined on three salads - Tuna on a rocket Thai happiness and Psp I love you, all mouthwatering delicious decisions.
This really is a most welcoming addition to the plethora of places to eat in the hustle and bustle of Saigon. I for one would strongly suggest a visit there you will not be disappointed, I will be back.

Fresh Salad, Friendly Staff
May 2015 • Friends
Just noticed this small store during lunch time with my colleagues. Decided to try it out the next day. Very pleased with it.

The salad box is lovely, fresh salad and tasty dressing. We got Caesar and Nicoise, both were delicious. Will try others next time.
I also tried the "Gac" juice (1st time heard about this fruit), love it.
Price range is quite a bargain compared to nearby restaurants.

For big eater, I recommend to add some extra ingredients to the standard portion. Or the store should provide an upsize option.

Overall, nice experience. Added to my favorite list.
Keep it up, guys.
